title: Peruvian Chicken Aji De Gallina
description: Tender chicken in aji amarillo pepper sauce served with snow peas and rice, this Peruvian dish is a must try for brunch, its resinous flavor will leave you wanting more.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and blanch the snow peas for 2 minutes.
Remove the snow peas from the pot with a slotted spoon and set aside.
Add the chicken breast to the pot and poach for 15 minutes or until cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the pot and let it cool.
In a blender, puree the aji amarillo peppers, garlic, and heavy cream until smooth.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and pour in the pepper sauce.
Shred the cooled chicken and add it to the skillet, stirring to coat with the sauce.
Add the parmesan cheese, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
To serve, place a portion of the chicken and sauce on a tagliere, top with snow peas and serve with cooked white rice.
